# We'll use email as the unique identifier for matching.

venmo_friend_emails = set(friend["email"].lower() for friend in all_venmo_friends if friend.get("email"))
phone_contact_emails = set(contact["email"].lower() for contact in phone_contacts if contact.get("email"))

# Friends to unfriend: in Venmo but not in phone contacts
emails_to_unfriend = venmo_friend_emails - phone_contact_emails

# Friends to add: in phone contacts but not in Venmo
emails_to_add = phone_contact_emails - venmo_friend_emails

print("emails_to_add:", emails_to_add)
